DREAD.IRONCLAD.description: Ironclad's Dominion: at the start of each combat, all enemies gain 1 Demon Form.
DREAD.SILENT.description: The Silent's Dominion: at the start of every combat, you lose 1 Strength and gain 1 Weak (in Elite combats: 2 Strength and 2 Weak).
DREAD.DEFECT.description: Defect's Dominion: at the end of your turn, take 3 damage for each enemy.
DREAD.NECROBINDER.description: Necrobinder's Dominion: at the start of your turn, a random card in your hand costs 1 more this turn.
DREAD.REGENT.description: Regent's Dominion: whenever an enemy attacks you, you lose 1 Strength this turn.
DREAD.WATCHER_DEVOTION.description: The Watcher's Dominion: at the start of every combat, all enemies gain 2 [gold]Devotion[/gold] (at the start of your turn each enemy gains 2 [gold]Mantra[/gold]; at 10 [gold]Mantra[/gold] it spends 10 and enters [gold]Divinity[/gold], dealing triple attack damage that turn).
DREAD.FOOL.description: The Fool's Dominion: at the start of every combat, add 2 [gold]Sadness[/gold] to your draw pile.
